title: Smoked and burned 1st time using it. Worthless.
text:
Smoked and burned 1st time using it. Worthless.. Up-date. I just called this company again..Very RUDE (christy), and kept me waiting on the phone for over 20mins, although they said the wait would be 4 mins!. Then switched me to someone else.
Waited more time..
Btw I called them last week, and Nobody called me back!
This will not be replaced from Proctor silex - Hamilton beach, and I would NEVER buy any of there products again.
They do not stand behind there faulty products..It burned up the first time using it. Seriously.
If I could give this food processor & company below a 0 star I would .
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Worthless.
The first time I used this Proctor Silex food processor to grate two Carrots for a carrot salad, this started to Smoke and smell like an electrical Fire.
It smoked so bad, I had to leave my Kitchen etc.Open doors and windows.. I have a open kitchen to my living room and dinning room.
My Husband could smell it in the tv room.

I unplug it, and just thought it might be smoking from the new oil on the motor!
Waited about 2 hours, tried it again, and it started to Smoke and Burn again..

I called Proctor Silex, which is Hamilton Beach. I Was told the waiting time was 4 mins..Waited 10 mins..Nothing.
But a recording came on to say to leave my phone number and they would call me Right back.
Yes, they called back, a couple of hours later. Asked me to email in the recite, and Cut the cord, and take a picture and email that also, which I did, but so far, I keep getting the same emails !!! To email both into them, and they would send me another one!
NOT So...I keep emailing picture and recite, still nothing.
I have not received anything from them, but more formed emails!..
Btw I have called them back about 3 times, and they keep telling me to email again!!
I have nothing good to say about this food processed, or Proctor Silex-Hamilton Beach.
Except if this worked it might be nice. Although cheaply made.
I noticed when it grated the carrot it left 1/4 in. of carrot twilling around on top of the grater.

Save your money for one that is better.
If they send me another one, and it works, I'll add another review to this one.

Two thumbs Down.
